rule: openIssues ↑ across a clean iter is thoroughness (a deeper scan surfacing more findings), NOT regression. The health signal is fixes.applied + regressions:0 + green pytest + clean lint gates, NOT the openIssues delta.
why: The parent generates the openIssues + deltaFromLast narrative; medium effort scans more files/dimensions so openIssues naturally rises even on a clean run (iter-4 46→56, iter-9 43→51, iter-10 51→59 were all clean). Reading a rise as regression would wrongly alarm the operator.
source: seeded (mirrors lesson-8; report-phase belongs to the parent, not the review-optimize child)
